assignment: Write a release recommendation for an analytical data manager using the supplied optical readings.
source: A reporting rule subtracts the matching batch blank. Sample A reads 0.52 absorbance units with blank 0.04. Sample B reads 0.54 with blank 0.09. The method flags blanks above 0.06. Duplicate readings differed by 0.01. A draft report says B is higher because 0.54 exceeds 0.52.

criteria.full: Computes corrected A = 0.48 and B = 0.45 and reverses the draft's raw ordering.
criteria.partial: Recognizes blank correction but gets a number or the ordering wrong.

criteria.full: Flags B's 0.09 blank against 0.06 and explains why close duplicates do not correct systematic bias.
criteria.partial: Flags the threshold or mentions duplicates without interpreting the distinction.

criteria.full: Proposes a qualified hold or governed release for B and a check of the matching blank or batch record.
criteria.partial: Recommends repeating work without identifying the affected result.

criteria.full: Gives defensible report wording which separates observed differences from conclusions pending quality review.
criteria.partial: Flags uncertainty but repeats the raw ordering as conclusive.
